messages:
Ethan Carter: Heads up — Nimbus Therapeutics invoice INV-2026-042 ($42,350) is 18 days overdue. They previously asked for net-60. Need a collections plan before EOD. Who can pick this up?
Samira Patel: I can take this. Do we have a point of contact? Last email said they were disputing usage overage.
Ethan Carter: Contact is Mara Jensen <mara@nimbustx.com>. Dispute: three high-usage runs on Mar 7.
Priya Menon: I'll pull the reconciliations. If it's a legitimate test, we can credit it. Any ask for discount or just a schedule?
Samira Patel: No discount requested — they want to spread payments. Suggest 3-installment plan starting May 1, waive late fee if paid on schedule. Agree?
Luke Huang: Ops dug into logs — there's a spike matching a load test tag `LT-9321`. If they provide the run ID we can credit ~$4,200.
Samira Patel: Perfect. I'll ask Mara for run ID and propose payment schedule. Plan to include contingency: missed payment => revert to full balance + late fees.
FinanceBot: account status updated: COLLECTIONS_PENDING. Auto-reminder scheduled in 14d. Escalate to Director Finance if unpaid.
Ethan Carter: Samira — can you send draft email by 3pm? CC Priya + Luke. I'll prepare to escalate to Director if no response.
Samira Patel: On it. I'll post the draft in #finance-drafts for quick review.
Priya Menon: Reconciled usage attached: https://redwood-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/finance/nimbus-recon-2026-04-14.csv — shows $4,200 test runs eligible for credit.
Samira Patel: Thanks — including a $4,200 credit line in the proposal. Sending now.
Samira Patel: Sent to mara@nimbustx.com at 2026-04-14 14:12. Proposed: 3 monthly installments (May/Jun/Jul), immediate $4,200 credit pending run ID, waive late fee if schedule met. CC'd Legal. Follow-up set for 2026-04-21. :email:
